limitations: One cold source capability per mode; server, database and OS caches are not flushed.
Test-only React ref traversal obtains the existing map; public MapLibre methods replace the source and preserve its layers without changing product code.
Source load and idle observations are not time-to-usable-render; no 3-second product render pass is inferred.
Remote shared Chromium scheduling/software rendering and a single run are not a production benchmark.

export_metadata.note: Fresh browser-only rerun. Raw browser artifact and prior Go/browser evidence are unchanged; original capture flags and measurements are preserved.

seed.note: Seed-only duration is reported only from the Go fixture; driver wall time includes build/startup.
